text:
olivia (Marketing): Heads-up team 12; publishing the inference playbook tomorrow at 09:00 PT. Small change: executive quote updated, legal asked to remove one partner logo. Quick alignment: press, social, support, product. who can own notes?

sam (PR): I got this. Will prep embargo mail for 08:55 PT and run the reporter briefing link at 08:58 PT. Excluding syndication partners until logo approval.

ravi (Growth): Paid queues ready. Holding 15% extra budget for initial surge. UTMs: utm_campaign=playbook_march&utm_medium=social. Will test preview at 08:50 PT.

mai (Design): Updated hero and social cards uploaded (logo-free variant): drive.redwood/playbook/creative/v3. Also exported OG in required sizes.

hannah (Legal): Confirmed: remove partner logo and any comparative language. Quotes are cleared after minor wording tweak.

diego (Product): Product on standby 08:30-10:00 PT. We'll monitor p95 latency and KV cache hit rate. If latency spikes >25% we'll enable reduced batch mode.

kevin (Support): Support staffing confirmed 08:40-10:30 PT. Adding a 3-item FAQ to the press kit: measurement, expected impact, where to report issues.

deploy-bot: scheduled preview: staging.playbook.redwood at 08:58 PT. Smoke probe at 08:59 PT.

sam (PR): Draft embargo snippet: "Hi <name>, Embargoed until 09:00 PT on 2026-03-28: Redwood Inference will publish the Cost & Efficiency Playbook. We can share embargoed assets and offer a 10-min briefing at 08:58 PT. Best, Sam"

olivia (Marketing): Please do NOT include raw CSVs in the embargo package. Include summarized charts only. Also watermark embargoed files with "NO SYNDICATION" where applicable.

ravi (Growth): I'll hold syndication reposts until legal gives green. Posting cadence suggested: 09:05 PT (announce), 12:00 PT (deep thread), 16:00 PT (customer spotlight).

mai (Design): GIFs and short clips are in the creative folder. If legal signs off on logos before 11:00 we'll swap assets in the second wave.

sam (PR): Timeline recap: 08:40 PT final asset check, 08:55 PT embargo send, 08:58 PT reporter briefing, 08:59 PT smoke probe, 09:00 PT lift embargo and publish. I'll ping #marketing and #presswire at each step.

kevin (Support): I'll monitor #support-live and update oncounts if needed. Please add the short troubleshooting lines to the press kit so first-touch replies are fast.

diego (Product): Noted. I'll post the monitoring dashboard link here at 08:57 PT.

hannah (Legal): Final note: any customer names mentioned in quotes must have explicit approval; avoid naming until confirmed.

olivia (Marketing): Great. Emoji check: :rocket: :white_check_mark: :eyes: See you tomorrow morning and flag any blockers here.
